name: Koch family
note: Founding family of New Era Cap: Ehrhardt Koch started the company in 1920 in Buffalo, New York (ACON Investments news release, 4 August 2022), and Chris Koch, the fourth-generation scion of the family, leads it (Reuters via FashionNetwork, 8 September 2023). Reuters reported in September 2023 that the company is controlled by its founding family, with private equity firm ACON Investments holding a significant minority stake (initially invested January 2021). Not related to Koch Industries.
